insight.headline: The `automaticDiscounts` query is removed in API version 2027-01
insight.what_changed: The deprecated automaticDiscounts query is removed from the GraphQL Admin API in version 2027-01. If your app reads a shop’s automatic discounts through automaticDiscounts, you need to move to the discountNodes query with a method:automatic filter before you upgrade to 2027-01. Apps on 2026-10 and earlier keep working unchanged while those versions are supported. What changed As of API version 202…
